decisions.text: type line: a regular series whose pattern of change is the point (06 DP6-1, G1.51)
the values are not far from zero compared with their spread
each line its own colour, handed out top to bottom by the line ends: Clinic D slot 1, Clinic C slot 2, Clinic A slot 3, Clinic B slot 4
each line labelled at its end, in the text grey, none moved
no point markers: no value is isolated and no straight run hides one
highlighted, twice as thick, in the strong shade of its hue, its label bold: Clinic B; the others keep their colours and widths
the unit phrase on the top label: “80K vaccinations per month”; the top gridline starts after it
digits hidden: thousands, stated once on the top label (R2-05, D-3): “80K vaccinations per month”
time axis: row 2 (“2022”) left out, the title gives it (G2.37)
the title wraps onto two lines
comment 1 (“Free parking at Clinic B ended in March”) in empty space inside the plot, 1 arrow to b at 2022-03 (G8.7)
comment 2 (“Bring back free parking soon”) in empty space inside the plot, 1 arrow to b at 2022-06 (G8.7)
the maker's comments in New Computer Modern italic, in the reserved blue, set apart from the labelling and outside its count of text styles (G6.3, D-19)
the four questions answered: what matters: the title; what explains it: comment 1; what to do: comment 2 (not answered: why care, which need be answered only where known) (G8.3)
